title: The Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic
summary: Unique prime factorisation, HCF and LCM, and proving numbers like √3 irrational.
objectives: I can write any composite number as a unique product of primes.
I can find HCF and LCM from prime factorisations.
I can use HCF × LCM = product for two numbers.
misconceptions: HCF × LCM = product works for three numbers too.
Factorisations can differ in more than order.
